key_terms.إِلْ‌يَاسِينَ: Prophet Elias (Ilyas), the vocative form indicating direct address.

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Prophet Ilyas (Elias)?
ai.summary: This verse concludes the narrative of Prophet Ilyas (Elias), affirming his status among the *Salihin* (righteous) and serving as a divine greeting of peace for his steadfastness in calling his people to monotheism. In Shia tradition, this specific invocation is often recited to honor the Prophet's role in purifying the people from idolatry, linking his struggle to the broader theme of prophetic continuity. It underscores the reward of peace for those who remain patient and faithful amidst societal corruption.
